Not worth it
Apr 2026 • Couples
Very overpriced as most of the tourist trap “balcony” restaurants seem to be, and the food came out cold, so dry and tasteless and very small portions for the price. Unfriendly, poor service where we were left unattended for pretty much the whole time we were there. Finally we’re given dirty drinking glasses and half the food came out a very long time after the rest. 
Didn’t feel there was any value for money, only positive was the proximity to the lake.

Apr 2025 • Friends

No prices indicated... we go up and discover prices twice as expensive as elsewhere! But we stay for the view ... it’s good, but no more ... and oh surprise: addition increased by a 10% tax!! We are told that it is indicated on the card brought to the table... in short! To flee!! Scam for tourists!!
